scene_description: Four children sit around a campfire in a fire pit. They are outdoors in a wooded area with trees and a green tent visible behind them. The children are seated in camping chairs and on the ground, and at least one child is holding a stick toward the fire.

questions.question: What is in the middle of the group?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round bowl on the ground between the children.

questions.question: Who is holding a stick toward the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person reaching a long stick toward the fire pit.

questions.question: What are the children sitting on?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is underneath the children on the sides.

questions.question: Where are the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground behind the children.

questions.question: What is behind the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big green shape behind the children.
